build_mcts_agent: build a single-process MCTS agent with a Sonnet network, model, optimizer, and replay server
create_replay_table: create a Reverb replay table with uniform sampling and FIFO removal for storing transitions
configure_nstep_adder: configure an NStepTransitionAdder to insert n-step discounted observations into the replay buffer
initialize_mcts_actor: initialize an MCTSActor with a network, model, discount factor, and number of simulations
setup_az_learner: set up an AZLearner with a network, optimizer, batched dataset, and discount factor
